local_review.finding_body: The resolved evidence identified dynamic-access call sites in both CredentialFactoryProvider and InternalConnectorRegistry, but the contribution originally provided only CredentialFactoryProviderTest.java. InternalConnectorRegistry therefore lacked the dedicated test file required by §root/FS-test-contract.1.8.
local_review.finding_title: Dynamic-access class lacked a dedicated test file
local_review.fix_note: Added InternalConnectorRegistryTest.java with a public-API registry scenario using offline credentials, then ran Forge finalization to regenerate the affected library coverage statistics and verify the repaired tree.
local_review.review_comment: Validated the single-coordinate closed file set, accepted metadata format and presence, public version-agnostic package-separated tests, absence of Native Image skips or unjustified flags, and the reported 4/4 (100%) dynamic-access coverage. The entry-count mismatch probe does not trigger for 4 covered calls against 85 reported library-plus-test-only entries. After repair, the exact Forge finalizer passed all three test lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validity, and stable statistics without further publishable changes.
